text: George Orwell's preface to the Ukrainian edition of Animal Farm (1947)
title: Why Orwell Wrote Animal Farm
prompt: Read Orwell's preface to the Ukrainian edition of Animal Farm. In about five paragraphs, explain two central ideas in the preface and how Orwell develops them, analyze how he uses rhetoric to make his purpose clear, and explain how the historical context of the Soviet Union shaped both the preface and the novel. Support each point with evidence quoted from the preface and explain it. Organize your essay with a clear claim, transitions, and a conclusion, and proofread for conventions.
